description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate common fish item icons arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top row: a rainbow trout with a pink side stripe, a grayling with a tall sail-like dorsal fin, a small silver mountain minnow, a mottled brown stone loach. Bottom row: an arctic char with an orange-red belly, a slim silver herring, a big olive-grey cod with a chin barbel, a small translucent pale ice smelt. Every fish drawn in side view facing right, no water, no bubbles. Ordinary everyday fish, natural colors, no glow, no sparkles. Chunky simple game item icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every item fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
